                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Helper to get database connection\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const getDb = async () => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const Database = (await import("better-sqlite3")).default;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return new Database("/home/user/inventory-app/data/inventory.db");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'};\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Route loader to get all products and their current quantities (sum of deltas)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export const useProductsLoader = routeLoader$(async () => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const db = await getDb();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const products = db.prepare(`\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      SELECT \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        p.id, \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        p.sku, \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        p.name, \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        COALESCE(SUM(sm.delta), 0) AS quantity\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      FROM products p\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      LEFT JOIN stock_movements sm ON p.id = sm.product_id\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      GROUP BY p.id\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    `).all() as { id: number; sku: string; name: string; quantity: number }[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return products;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  } finally {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    db.close();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Route action to handle stock adjustments (receive/ship)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export const useMovementAction = routeAction$(\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  async (data, { fail }) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const { productId, type, quantity } = data;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Validate inputs\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!/^\\d+$/.test(productId)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return fail(400, { message: "Product ID must be an integer" });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!/^\\d+$/.test(quantity)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return fail(400, { message: "Quantity must be a positive integer" });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const prodId = parseInt(productId, 10);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const qty = parseInt(quantity, 10);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (qty <= 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return fail(400, { message: "Quantity must be a positive integer" });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (type !== "receive" && type !== "ship") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return fail(400, { message: "Type must be either receive or ship" });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const db = await getDb();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const tx = db.transaction(() => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        // Check if product exists\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const product = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM products WHERE id = ?").get(prodId);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if (!product) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          throw new Error("Product does not exist");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        // Compute current quantity\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const row = db.prepare(`\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0) AS quantity\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          FROM stock_movements\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          WHERE product_id = ?\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        `).get(prodId) as { quantity: number } | undefined;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const currentQty = row ? row.quantity : 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const delta = type === "receive" ? qty : -qty;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if (type === "ship" && currentQty < qty) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          throw new Error("Insufficient stock");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        // Insert movement\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        db.prepare(`\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          INSERT INTO stock_movements (product_id, delta, reason)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        `).run(prodId, delta, type);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // Execute transaction with immediate lock\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      tx.immediate();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return { success: true };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err: any) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return fail(400, { message: err.message || "An error occurred" });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } finally {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      db.close();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  zod$({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    productId: z.string(),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    type: z.string(),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    quantity: z.string(),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  })\n'[39m +
                  [32m');\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +

                  [32m'          {products.value.map((product) => (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <div \n'[39m +

                  [32m'              style={{ \n'[39m +
                  [32m'                display: "flex", \n'[39m +

            [32m'1. Directory Verification:\n'[39m +

            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Only create commits when requested by the user. If unclear, ask first. When the user asks you to create a new git commit, follow these steps carefully:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Git Safety Protocol:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER update the git config\n'[39m +
            [32m"- NEVER run destructive git commands (push --force, reset --hard, checkout ., restore ., clean -f, branch -D) unless the user explicitly requests these actions. Taking unauthorized destructive actions is unhelpful and can result in lost work, so it's best to ONLY run these commands when given direct instructions \n"[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER skip hooks (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, etc) unless the user explicitly requests it\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER run force push to main/master, warn the user if they request it\n'[39m +

Instead, after hook failure, fix the issue, re-stage, and create a NEW commit\n'[39m +

            [32m'4. If the commit fails due to pre-commit hook changes, retry the commit ONCE to include these automated changes.
